author: Claude (Cloudreach Meshy generation worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 24 m long x 5 m wide span, ~12 m tall arch

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: One span of a monumental stone arch bridge, 24 metres long and 5 metres wide, a single large rounded arch about 12 metres tall, built of pale weathered limestone voussoirs and blocks, square stone piers at both ends, a balustrade parapet along both sides with small gold-capped posts, and royal-blue banners with a pale wing emblem and gold trim hanging on the piers. Matches the bridge reference exactly in style. Show the full span from a three-quarter view. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.
concepts.verdict: rejected: views disagreed on number of piers/arches

concepts.prompt: A single modular bridge segment: exactly ONE large rounded stone arch spanning between exactly TWO square stone piers, total length 24 metres, deck width 5 metres, arch crown about 12 metres above the pier feet. Pale weathered limestone voussoirs and ashlar blocks, a flat walkway deck on top with a stone balustrade parapet along both long sides and small gold-capped posts, one royal-blue banner with a pale wing emblem and gold trim hanging on the outer face of each pier. The bridge is a solid, closed, symmetric object; both ends are clean flat cut faces where it connects to the next segment. Exactly as in the bridge arch reference. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no people. Pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with soft moss in the joints; royal-blue banner fabric with gold trim; gold accents. Absolutely no red, no oxblood anywhere.

visual_verdict: Strong: single round arch between two piers, balustrade with gold-capped posts, blue wing banners; 24 m long, 5.7 m wide, 17.7 m tall overall. Matches bridge_arch reference closely.
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
